candidates.change_summary: Return a different constant (zero) instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.

Make notDelegated() silently return (no revert) when called in delegate context by removing the revert, changing behavior so proxiableUUID can be called via delegatecall without reverting and thus may return the normal slot from implementation.
Replace C.initialize so it does NOT call __UUPSUpgradeable_init(), leaving only Access initialization (changes initialized flag behavior visible via Initializable).
Modify Initializable.initializer to set _initialized to 2 instead of 1, changing reported initialized version after initialize() completes.
